item.title: Travis Scott Watches Drake’s Anita Max Win Tour via FaceTime—Concerts Will Never Be the Same
item.description: Ok… it’s happening. The dystopia is REAL. TRAVIS SCOTT—the man who just sold out SoFi Stadium and MetLife Stadium like it was a 7-Eleven on a Tuesday—decided that actually showing up to see Drake perform in Melbourne was too much effort.
